content:
maya: FYI rolling BMC fw v2.3.1 to eu-central1 and ap-northeast1 right now. seeing ~0.5% of nodes come back with the boot flag flipped (UEFI variable lock -> secure boot ON) which breaks our PXE flow for provisioner v1.

deploy-bot: deploy started: bmc-fw/v2.3.1 -> eu-central1 (canary 5 nodes) at 3123456789

samir: which racks? impact on GPU pools?

maya: primarily racks r12, r13 in eu-central, and r8 in ap-northeast. affected nodes stuck in "oob-unverified" state, provisioning fails -> stays in reserved pool. GPUs can't be scheduled so we lose capacity.

cheng: logs show the BMC image writes a UEFI var: `SecureBootEnable = 1` for certain vendor hwids. maybe layout mismatch in vendor bin. snippet from bmc serial: ```
2026-03-20T21:13:02Z BMC fw: write UEFI VAR SecureBootEnable=1 hwid=0x4c
2026-03-20T21:13:02Z pxe: no fallback, waiting for signed pxelinux.efi
```

lina: cost angle — nodes stuck in reserved state still incur committed GPU billing. raising if we don't free them quick.

maya: can we pause rollout and run a targeted fix? suggested plan: 1) pause, 2) run canary remediation on 3 nodes with manual var clear, 3) push hotfix image to remaining.

infra-oncall: paused rollout (eu-central1) at 3123456795 :rotating_light:

samir: remediation command I used on one node: `ipmitool -I lanplus -H $BMC -U admin -P **** raw 0x30 0x70 0x0c 0x01 0x00` (this toggles the vendor var clear on our hw). followed by `fleetctl reprovision --node $NODE --force-wipe`. worked on 2/2 test nodes in r12. share runbook snippet: ```
# clear signed-boot flag via BMC vendor raw
ipmitool -I lanplus -H $BMC -U admin -P $PWD raw 0x30 0x70 0x0c 0x01 0x00
sleep 3
fleetctl reprovision --node $NODE --image=provisioner-v1 --force-wipe
```

cheng: caveat — that raw command only applies to vendor X hwid 0x4c. DO NOT run on others; it can brick older boards. check `dmidecode | grep Vendor` first.

lina: can we limit billing impact by marking stuck nodes as reclaimable and moving workloads to burst pool? need buy-in from cost team.

maya: temporary move: set queue weight low and enable burst-cap for critical clusters. I'll open a cost ticket.

deploy-bot: rollback completed on eu-central1 canary at 3123456810 (r12 test nodes) :white_check_mark:

infra-oncall: manual remediation running on r12/r13, r8 queued in ap-northeast. target to finish manual clears in 30m then resume with vendor-hotfix image.

maya: followups: 1) vendor patch validation for UEFI var behavior, 2) add a preflight check to detect `SecureBootEnable` set post-flash, 3) add soft-fail fallback in provisioner so nodes can fall back to signed pxelinux if possible.

samir: adding preflight check to canary job now — pushing script to CI. link to patch once ready.

lina: created cost ticket INC-6421 for transient GPU billing; tagging finance.

maya: thanks all — will update when manual remediations complete.
